as_told.title: Descartes as a Jesuit agent setting up a mechanistic paradigm to keep the occult under church authority

plain: René Descartes was secretly an agent of the Jesuits, according to the philosopher Jason Jorjani. In one episode Jorjani says the Jesuits sent Descartes to infiltrate the Rosicrucians, a secretive brotherhood devoted to hidden knowledge, and he points to his own book Prometheus and Atlas. In a later episode he tells it differently: Descartes's job was to set up a strictly mechanical kind of science so that the occult, the hidden knowledge, would stay under the church's control. Either way, it would mean modern science was shaped to keep certain knowledge locked away.
